scripts.clean: node --eval "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.format: prettier --write package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.build.json eslint.config.mjs vitest.config.ts src tests README.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.build.json eslint.config.mjs vitest.config.ts src tests README.md
scripts.check: pnpm test && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm build
